Brand.name: Shipping Platform
Brand.tagline: Sea-freight quotes from vetted forwarders worldwide.

Landing.hero: Compare sea-freight quotes from vetted forwarders.
Landing.subhero: Post a shipment, receive bids from licensed freight forwarders, book and pay securely, and track your container to delivery.
Landing.ctaCoworker: I am a local transport provider
Landing.step1Body: Origin port, destination port, container type, ready date.
Landing.step2Body: Forwarders bid with price, transit time, and carrier.
Landing.step3Body: Pay securely via Stripe. Track each stage of your shipment.
Landing.browseProviders: Or browse our forwarders, pickup coworkers, and customs agents →

Onboarding.title: Forwarder onboarding
Onboarding.intro: Stripe handles your KYC, identity verification, and payouts globally. You'll be redirected to Stripe to enter your business details and bank account, then sent back here.
Onboarding.introMock: Onboarding is currently in mock mode — no real KYC, no bank link. One click marks you as ready to submit quotes. The real payment provider will be wired in before launch.
Onboarding.mockBadge: Mock mode — payments are simulated. Set PAYMENT_PROVIDER=stripe in .env to switch.
Onboarding.returnedNotComplete: Stripe says onboarding is not complete yet. You may need to add more details or your account may still be under review.
Onboarding.compliance: By onboarding, you confirm you are licensed to provide freight-forwarding services in your jurisdiction and accept the platform terms.
